Title: Management of Failed Carpal and Cubital Tunnel Release: An Evidence-Based Guide to Success
Abstract: An alternative to isolated nerve <m>transposition</m> is that of <m>medial</m> <m>epicondylectomy</m>. This involves elevating the flexor-pronator origin subperiosteally off the epicondyle while taking care to protect the <m>anterior</m> bundle of the <m>medial</m> collateral ligament.

Title: Is simple decompression enough for the treatment of idiopathic cubital tunnel syndrome: A prospective comparative study analyzing the outcomes of simple decompression versus partial medial epicondylectomy
Abstract: In another <m>meta</m>-<m>analysis</m> by Macadam et al., 10 <m>randomized</m> controlled <m>trials</m> comparing <m>simple</m> <m>decompression</m> with <m>anterior</m> <m>transposition</m> were analyzed.
